conclusion: Explicit-buffer factory 0x825184D0 reaches creator 0x82533DB8 through device vtable 0x8204A1B0 slot +0x08 at pre-call boundary 0x82518608, with config words +0x00, +0x04, and +0x40 in r4, r5, and r7, fixed r6=1, and fixed r8=0; 0x8251860C is only the call continuation. The creator builds a 0x34-byte header, executes allocator instructions 0x82533E98 and 0x82533EB0 with continuations 0x82533E9C and 0x82533EB4, and reaches the special heap path 0x8280DAC0 -> 0x8281B4F0 -> 0x82811658. Refcount-zero cleanup reaches classifier call 0x82518B60 and post-call continuation 0x82518B64; for the accepted device vtable, classifier codes 3, 17, 18, and 19 select exact manager targets 0x825348A8, 0x825349F8, 0x82534950, and 0x82533D10, while code 20 performs no indirect device release. The target bodies update manager bookkeeping or return success, not a proved backing free. Static code proves no allocation-generation token, backing contents producer, or address-reuse event. A default-off input/release observation plus bounded returned-range write tracking is proposed; no reuse observation is admissible before a lower-free proof, and alternate factory 0x82517EC0 remains a separate runtime gate.
